summaries.inventoryScope: system Docker only; rootless workloads can be unmapped
system Docker plus four rootless daemons

findings.finding: Host steal remains well above the 5% target without synthetic HTTP load, including a window when the production API used only 0.751 CPU seconds.
43 running containers share four vCPUs across the system Docker daemon and four rootless daemons. Container count alone does not establish saturation or causality.

The API has a separate 1.5-CPU cgroup quota and was throttled in 40/144 active quota periods in the first window; no API quota throttling in the second window. These fractions are not fractions of requests or elapsed time.

The API quota and hypervisor steal are distinct constraints. The second window supports investigating host/hypervisor capacity independently of the monthly calculation; it does not identify a specific neighboring VM or prove the provider cause.

No OOM event in the monitored filtroAPP application/database cgroups; about 9 GiB host memory was available at the start of the first window. I/O spikes were observed but the short windows do not establish sustained disk saturation.

actionsPrepared.action: Publish the local calendar optimization through staging, compare response-only cache with the baseline, and evaluate API quota throttling again after CPU work falls.
actionsPrepared.execution: manual deployment by operator; not performed

actionsPrepared.action: Provide the UTC windows, steal series and low-API-use second window to the hosting provider; ask for physical CPU scheduling/capacity and any host-level rate limit to be checked.

Coordinate performance comparisons away from simultaneous builds/deployments/tests on the shared VPS. Reassess per-application resource budgets using sustained measurements; caps are not reservations.
actionsPrepared.execution: planning only; no quotas or schedules changed

actionsPrepared.action: Complete 24-hour/seven-day CPU/latency/queue/OOM observation and browser/role/write coverage before production cache acceptance.
actionsPrepared.execution: pending; short windows do not close these gates

limitations: Two short windows of 45 samples each, not 24-hour monitoring. Natural traffic, deployments and other workloads continued.
Each sampling loop has diagnostic overhead; the first collector averaged about 5.5% of one core in its top-process samples.
Per-process top-eight samples omit quieter or short-lived processes; use complete cgroup usage deltas for container totals.
First-window process labels only map the system daemon; rootless processes may be marked host. Second-window mapping includes all daemons.
No host/hypervisor telemetry beyond the guest is available. No application, quota, cron, backup or container lifecycle was changed on the VPS.

definitions.steal: KVM reports time a vCPU did not run, excluding its idle time.
definitions.cpuStat: nr_throttled counts quota-throttled periods; cpu.max configures allowed CPU bandwidth, not a reservation.
